content: TabAPI v1 has NO endpoint for 'related Google advertisers' or an ad-creative library for a domain. Nearest capabilities: (1) Google Search API (GET /search/google, 1 credit) returns paid_results (position, placement top|bottom, title, link, snippet) per QUERY — a domain-to-advertisers bridge can synthesize ads from the domain's top keywords' SERPs; (2) Reverse AdSense API (3 credits) maps a publisher id to domains, not advertisers to a domain. No first/last-seen dates, no impressions, no spend estimates, no advertiser entity list. Semrush-style Competitors/Ad Copies/Ads History views cannot be fully replicated; scope must shrink to observed SERP ads per keyword.
